PHASE.NAME: Product Truth and Release Discipline
PHASE.GOAL: Align public documentation, release metadata, version guards, and supply-chain checks with shipped Linux/macOS behavior

PLANNED_WORK.step-1: Block ghost CLI commands and unsupported install URLs across README, INSTALL, COMMANDS, FAQ, and QUICKSTART.
PLANNED_WORK.step-2: Add release tag versus Cargo.toml version guard and packaged syn --version assertion.
PLANNED_WORK.step-3: Harden source fallback with cargo install --locked and update installer verification coverage.
PLANNED_WORK.step-4: Decide cargo audit warning policy, then update notify or gate warnings explicitly.

ACCEPTANCE.CHECK: No public docs mention unsupported commands, unsupported Windows install path, obsolete synapse-ai URLs, or synapse.dev/install.sh as a shell installer
Release artifacts carry non-empty release notes or generated release notes
